scenario_description:
Objective: Notice a brief chance to add a meaningful photo-preservation stop to an already planned Saturday outing.
Emerging Need: A free local scanning appointment would fit a saved preference, but only once the slot details and grocery-handling logistics make the outing workable.
Decision Context: The prior note identifies which optional session is worth considering; calendar, contact, email, and message updates narrow the viable time and confirmation path.
Consequence: Timely coordination could secure a pleasant extra benefit with no required spending, while inaction merely leaves the original grocery ride unchanged once openings fill.

parameter.title: Saturday grocery ride with Dad
parameter.description: Pick up refrigerated groceries with Dad and return them home afterward unless logistics change.

parameter.name: Evanston Public Library Memory Lab
parameter.notes: Handles short no-cost photo-scanning appointments; same-day holds must be confirmed by phone and are released if unused.

parameter.subject: Saturday pop-up scanning openings
parameter.body: A volunteer cancellation opened two 20-minute no-cost scanning appointments at the Main Library Memory Lab on Saturday, May 2: 11:20 AM and 11:40 AM. A name and mobile number are enough to hold one; confirmations close at 12:30 PM today and unused holds are released automatically. Bring up to 12 photos; no drop-off storage.

parameter.content: If Saturday groceries run long, I can meet you at Maple Avenue Market at 11:05 and take the cold bags home. I’ll keep my phone on until 12:15.

parameter.subject: Saturday scanning openings filled
parameter.body: The May 2 pop-up appointments are now filled. We can only add additional names to next month’s interest list.
